issues.title: SillyNovel M1.2-C: Import and register a small approved raster asset library
issues.description:
## Objective

Create a small, explicitly user-approved background/sprite raster library **only after** <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue> produces sufficient ownership/storage evidence and the owner separately approves the selected architecture and implementation scope. This is a downstream gated ticket, **not authorized to start by issue creation**.

## Prerequisites and blockers

* <issue id="68a64d40-8ef5-4762-9d09-286440e02951" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-19/sillynovel-m12-a-prove-chatcard-identity-and-assetmetadata-storage">DYL-19</issue> proved SillyTavern's background filenames are mutable and did **not** prove extension-owned immutable revisions, identity, export, quotas or safe metadata saving.
* **Blocked by** <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue>: verify a supported owner-scoped import/read/remove contract and receive the corresponding owner storage/portability decision. A completed report with `BLOCKED` findings does *not* automatically satisfy this prerequisite.
* Read merged `docs/M1_IDENTITY_STORAGE.md`, <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue>'s eventual reviewed report, `docs/M1_PLAN.md`, `docs/ASSETS_AND_PROVIDERS.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and main. No dependency on the pure reducer's implementation internals beyond agreed registry reference shapes.

## Scope

* Explicit manual import of PNG, **static** WebP and JPEG raster art; allow transparency for sprites. No generated/downloaded art, animations, remote paths or ZIP/pack importer.
* Validate actual decoded format, dimensions, bytes, image safety and extension-owned storage scope. Proposed ceilings (e.g., 10 MiB/file, 4096px edge, bounded total library) require measured checks and an explicit owner decision; do not assume values are approved limits.
* Extension namespaced logical `assetId`, **immutable** revision/content SHA-256, typed background vs character/sprite records, media type/dimensions, approved user labels, outfit/expression compatibility and optional attribution.
* Replacing a logical asset creates a new immutable revision without overwriting previous bytes. Readback must verify bytes/hash. Reject collisions, unsafe paths, corrupt/mismatched data and ambiguous character binding; never silently associate two same-named cards.
* Safe import/read/list/export/removal, explicit reference display, missing-art neutral fallback and cleanup restricted to proven extension-owned resources. Preserve referenced revisions or explicit tombstones instead of deleting another scene's assets.
* Keep image bytes out of extensionSettings and chat metadata; no unapproved browser-local persistence. Storage failure must preserve native chat and previously approved assets.

## Acceptance

* Automated tests: wrong mime/decoded content, corrupt and oversized images, animated WebP, format coercion, filename traversal, collisions, duplicate labels/cards, quota/error handling, immutable revision replacement, missing/corrupt assets, reference-safe removal, partial batch errors and export/round-trip.
* **Actual pinned-host** isolated read/write/reload/remove evidence for the specifically approved storage seam, verified user/account scope and no cross-owner writes; no risky host production writes or shared-file cleanup.
* Any unresolved mandatory seam is explicitly BLOCKED, not substituted by hidden browser storage or made to look like a PASS.
* Exact base/tested/pushed SHAs, fixture hashes, tests/results, honest gaps and registry contracts documented. One focused **OPEN/UNMERGED** PR; set Linear In Review only when reviewable.

## Scope exclusions

No scene UI, manual reducer, AI art/director, provider integration, automatic card assignment, durable scene-history persistence, migrations or M2. Gate A NOT_RUN. <issue id="986b0ad5-1141-4d3f-9df8-ba8d6c898392" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-20/sillynovel-m12-b-implement-the-pure-manual-scene-reducer-and-lock">DYL-20</issue> and <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue> may proceed independently; this issue remains Backlog/blocked until separately released.

## Completion/readiness proposal — 2026-10-15 (not owner approval)

Verified main ea65d84a521a39c9ccc977f4cb3643454963d4b8; PRs #23–27 merged, <issue id="708fec47-6d85-4d32-940b-0d6de2d9606c" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-49/sillynovel-adopt-independent-projects-and-optional-local-persistence">DYL-49</issue>–54/57–59 Done. This supplies account/project-scoped immutable PNG storage, CAS/global saves, saved-reference portability, full-store recovery and explicit unused deletion. It does not complete this ticket's reusable raster library. Original requirements above remain historical acceptance, including JPEG/static WebP, logical immutable revision replacement, labels/kinds, compatibility metadata, full catalog management and native-card assumptions.

Recommendation: REVISE this existing ticket to project-owned manual actor IDs; do not create a second asset-registry ticket or infer native identity from names/cards. First proposed vertical slice: labeled/kinded PNG alternatives that can be listed and explicitly reselected after reload/reopen, preserving immutable bytes, scene references, missing-art fallback and quota/error behavior. Follow with compatibility/expression-library completeness. Any real metadata/schema/portable-format transition must preserve old usable state and include backup/rollback/roundtrip tests under its reviewed scope; v1 recovery policy is not an implemented migration. No asset editor, packs, providers or persistent message history.

Acceptance: two alternatives/background and per actor survive reopen and explicit reselection, duplicate labels remain distinct, foreign/incompatible/ref-missing choices refuse, replacement preserves old bytes/refs, selected cleanup remains safe, rollback/CAS/version/quota failures preserve data. Require actual-entry and two-account pinned-host evidence, explicit native-file inventory, portable/backup compatibility; retain untested device/runtime limits.

Owner must approve revised prerequisite/card scope and any temporary PNG-only deferral. JPEG/WebP remain unmet until implemented or explicitly deferred, not erased. Keep Backlog and original <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue> blocker; no closure, unblock, implementation or release authorized by this planning update. Proposed order: this first slice → remaining <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue> → <issue id="705ea7ac-3580-47a4-87a8-863cd76f1ea7" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-60/sillynovel-m14-prepare-the-frozen-manual-stage-owner-playtest">DYL-60</issue>; release hardening <issue id="f2256cd4-2e37-4165-8c3c-7c041799e886" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-61/sillynovel-track-public-beta-and-production-storage-hardening">DYL-61</issue> separate.

[Full gap matrix/decision package](<https://github.com/Sonoran-Solutions/SillyNovel/blob/codex/m12-storage-readiness/docs/M1_2_STORAGE_COMPLETION_AND_READINESS.md>).

issues.title: SillyNovel M1.2-D: Render stable manual scenes and source-scoped controls
issues.description:
## Objective

Integrate the completed M1.1 reader with the **reviewed pure reducer** and **approved raster asset registry** to create a first usable manually controlled VN stage: one background, up to three stable character sprites, and source-scoped controls. **This downstream implementation is not authorized by ticket creation.**

## Dependencies and owner gate

* Blocked by <issue id="986b0ad5-1141-4d3f-9df8-ba8d6c898392" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-20/sillynovel-m12-b-implement-the-pure-manual-scene-reducer-and-lock">DYL-20</issue> (pure manual scene reducer) and <issue id="9a7c483c-4df5-4d13-82fb-98d473df1c64" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-22/sillynovel-m12-c-import-and-register-a-small-approved-raster-asset">DYL-22</issue> (verified/approved raster import registry). <issue id="7dff8082-00f8-4376-aaed-e1852be85c8c" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-18/sillynovel-m11-b-ship-the-text-reader-backlog-handoff-and-composer">DYL-18</issue> text reader is already Done.
* <issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue> may reveal remaining save/owner limitations. Do not ignore them. **Durable visual scene saving/reload is outside this ticket** and remains gated by <issue id="68a64d40-8ef5-4762-9d09-286440e02951" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-19/sillynovel-m12-a-prove-chatcard-identity-and-assetmetadata-storage">DYL-19</issue>/<issue id="b8a967f8-9a16-4846-94ab-da12c61402ba" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-21/sillynovel-m12-a2-investigate-safe-targeted-saves-and-owned-asset">DYL-21</issue> and later M1.3 work.
* Obtain explicit owner authorization for this UI slice, especially any deliberately **session-only/unsaved visual choices** if durable state is still unsupported. Never imply a session-only demo satisfies Gate A's reload requirement.
* Recheck actual main and read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/M1_PLAN.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/M1_IDENTITY_STORAGE.md`, reviewed <issue id="986b0ad5-1141-4d3f-9df8-ba8d6c898392" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-20/sillynovel-m12-b-implement-the-pure-manual-scene-reducer-and-lock">DYL-20</issue>/22 contracts, and <issue id="7dff8082-00f8-4376-aaed-e1852be85c8c" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-18/sillynovel-m11-b-ship-the-text-reader-backlog-handoff-and-composer">DYL-18</issue> renderer tests.

## Scope

* Keep original selected-message reader, safe formatting, Previous/Next/Latest, Copy, Backlog, composer/send/stop, and explicit native-feed recovery intact.
* Render one approved background plus at most three visible cutout sprites (left/center/right); maintain larger logical cast with distinct offstage labels and no arbitrary eviction. The visual stage is decorative; complete readable dialogue remains primary and independently scrollable.
* Use only verified/manual character bindings. Duplicate-name/unresolved authors retain host labels, no guessed speaker spotlight. Manual focus/position changes cannot silently alter native chats.
* User controls for background/location, visibility/presence, outfit, message-scoped expression, stable slot assignment and explicit swap/replace/release. Show lock scopes, invalidated historical choices and reasoned rejection/fallbacks. A deliberate user override is allowed even while that field is locked against automation/delayed results.
* Renderer consumes reducer projections and immutable catalog refs; it must never directly mutate reducer state or host chats. Handle missing/incompatible art, stale image decoding, failed imports and deleted/revised messages with neutral placeholders. No incompatible outfit/expression substitution.
* Preserve user interaction, native composer focus/drafts, source epoch, and stage lifecycle on A → B → A, Stop/Continue, swipes and disable. If visual controls or art fail, keep text reading/chat functional; fallback to standard host UI on core reader failure.
* Responsive layout: on narrow or keyboard-reduced viewports art collapses/yields space to dialogue and composer. Controls remain touch/keyboard usable without global key interception. No decorative animation required.

## Acceptance and evidence

* Actual-entry behavioral tests: bounded sprite count; 4+ member group including two same-name cards; unresolved speaker; occupied-slot swap/refusal and locks; manual expressions and changes to an older selected message; valid/invalid source anchors; stale image loads after chat switch; missing outfit/background fallback; explicit unsaved state; native backlog; repeated reader/native toggles; full reply/copy, stream/stop/continue, and failure restoration.
* Pinned-host synthetic run with one approved background/two sprite fixtures, actual controls, composer/draft preservation, group/same-name cases where reachable, desktop and narrow screenshots and failure scenario. Mark untested host behavior honestly.
* All M0/M1.1, reducer and asset-registry regressions stay passing. Record exact code/fixture/tested/pushed SHAs and non-persistent limits.
* One focused **OPEN/UNMERGED** PR; Linear In Review on handoff, not Done. An owner playtest of this initial manual stage is useful feedback but **does not** alone pass the full Gate A evaluation.

## Exclusions

No scene director, automatic art inference, image generation/cloud providers, host fork, replacement composer, backend/server plugin without owner decision, durable scene saves/migration, speculative browser-local fallback, or M2. Gate A remains NOT_RUN until the separately frozen full M1 candidate and owner verdict.

## Completion/readiness proposal — 2026-10-15 (not owner approval)

Verified main ea65d84a521a39c9ccc977f4cb3643454963d4b8; <issue id="81c8cdaf-bc0d-4920-aa0a-8f92dab921b6" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-24/sillynovel-m12-d0-prototype-session-only-manual-vn-stage">DYL-24</issue> supported and <issue id="1af5b2ac-67e6-47c2-828e-90e1d655fd12" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-53/sillynovel-integrate-saved-projects-with-the-manual-vn-stage">DYL-53</issue> global project stage implemented. Credit existing one-background/three-slot/larger-manual-cast, explicit swaps/presence/outfit/locks, transient source invalidation, missing art, safe native reader/composer and project reload/explicit reopen. Original acceptance above remains intact.

Recommendation: REVISE this ticket around remaining practical stage work, delivered in small reviewed slices after revised <issue id="9a7c483c-4df5-4d13-82fb-98d473df1c64" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-22/sillynovel-m12-c-import-and-register-a-small-approved-raster-asset">DYL-22</issue>. (1) Integrate reusable library and clear project/selected-entry/save/dirty/discard/detach/reopen/global-scope language. (2) Separately approved memory-only message-expression/source overlay while attached, source/swipe/edit/delete/continue/historical-correction invalidation, and explicit manual project use with four-member duplicate-name native groups. (3) Responsive, keyboard, touch/virtual-keyboard and error recovery verification. Reuse reducer/renderer; do not implement durable per-message history or invent native chat/card authority.

Acceptance: ≤3 stable sprites with 4+ logical actors, duplicate labels/unresolved speakers without guessed spotlight; explicit replace/swap/release, correct compatibility/missing-art fallback; A→B→A and stale image/hash/save receipts; stream/stop/continue and exact draft/composer/native backlog preservation. Show global project saves separately from transient source overlays. Require actual-entry tests, real pinned-host individual/group controls, desktop/narrow screenshots and identified physical touch/keyboard evidence. Any missing surface remains NOT_TESTED.

Owner must authorize revised group/overlay scope and Gate A persistence/writer amendment or retain those original gaps. Current project mode disables expressions and groups; global synthetic project anchor is not native correspondence. CAS is not a single-writer lease/read-only second tab. Keep Backlog and <issue id="7dff8082-00f8-4376-aaed-e1852be85c8c" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-18/sillynovel-m11-b-ship-the-text-reader-backlog-handoff-and-composer">DYL-18</issue>/20/22 blockers. No closure/unblock/implementation/M1.3/M2/Gate A verdict authorized. New planning-only <issue id="705ea7ac-3580-47a4-87a8-863cd76f1ea7" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-60/sillynovel-m14-prepare-the-frozen-manual-stage-owner-playtest">DYL-60</issue> is blocked by this ticket; <issue id="f2256cd4-2e37-4165-8c3c-7c041799e886" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-61/sillynovel-track-public-beta-and-production-storage-hardening">DYL-61</issue> release hardening does not block it.

[Full gap matrix/decision package](<https://github.com/Sonoran-Solutions/SillyNovel/blob/codex/m12-storage-readiness/docs/M1_2_STORAGE_COMPLETION_AND_READINESS.md>).

## <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue>-A owner-authorized scope — 2026-10-16

Owner explicitly authorized manual stage/project UX integration only: coherent Project, Scene and Artwork Library controls; attachment/save/recovery feedback; readable selection and locks; responsive/accessibility improvements; focused regressions and disposable pinned-host UI evidence; one focused draft PR for senior review. Reuse <issue id="81c8cdaf-bc0d-4920-aa0a-8f92dab921b6" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-24/sillynovel-m12-d0-prototype-session-only-manual-vn-stage">DYL-24</issue>, <issue id="1af5b2ac-67e6-47c2-828e-90e1d655fd12" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-53/sillynovel-integrate-saved-projects-with-the-manual-vn-stage">DYL-53</issue> and merged PR #29 catalog. This supersedes the historical implementation gate only for this bounded slice. Original acceptance and dependency relations remain. Attached source-expression overlays, native groups, persistent message history, remembered attachment, Decision F, Gate A, <issue id="918f7e83-b171-4601-b575-fa6c90f14884" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-55/sillynovel-add-portable-project-bundles-and-restore-policy">DYL-55</issue>, <issue id="705ea7ac-3580-47a4-87a8-863cd76f1ea7" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-60/sillynovel-m14-prepare-the-frozen-manual-stage-owner-playtest">DYL-60</issue> execution, M1.3/M2 and release remain outside authorization. No merge or auto-merge.

## <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue>-A implementation handoff — 2026-10-16

Draft PR <pull-request id="2bd392fb-fe83-4a51-9a4b-ef6fac667f38" href="https://linear.app/devils17/review/feat-integrate-manual-stage-and-project-ux-dyl-23-a-1b8183d038b7">Sonoran-Solutions/SillyNovel#30</pull-request> is OPEN / DRAFT / UNMERGED with auto-merge disabled. Starting main ad70bb52e0f46155a5c7b1e5c3da957536612dc9 is the verified merge of PR #29. Frozen implementation/test/runner SHA 646ec9e7bd1439cb2137e97edba9c1526c808db9.

Implemented Project/Scene/Artwork Library grouping and scene-action rows; always-visible attached project name/short UUID/revision and activation-only/global-scope text; current actor/background/outfit/presence/position/locks; explicit attached-UUID discard/reopen and cancellation; saved/dirty/pending/conflict/uncertain/error indicators; narrow dialogue/composer space and local Escape focus. Reused the existing catalog/reducer/CAS/model/session guards, cleanup preview/confirmation and selected-only portable v1. No schema, plugin, native association, reader, dependency or persistence-architecture change. Reopen after conflict/uncertain save is a conservative bounded engineering choice, not an owner amendment to Decision F.

Frozen checks: 91/91 Node, 126/126 storage/library/recovery/cleanup, 46/46 actual-entry Chromium, 24/24 actual disposable-host checkpoint groups; no failures/skips/cancellations. SillyTavern 1.19.0 at 7e8663cd9c184a550b37238218bdd32c6efc68e9, Node 26.8.1/SQLite 3.53.4/Linux, Chromium 151.0.7922.34. Real UI: four manually registered actors/two Mira labels/three slots/seven entries, presence/outfit/locks/save/dirty/save, detached reload/reopen, discard cancel, A→B→A, real peer conflict/lost committed receipt, native user send/stream/stop/backlog. Eight desktop/narrow screenshots; named native-file maps match 36/36 stage, 34/34 library and 65/65 migration. Native reply occurs after the visual-only hash comparison. Physical touch/IME/virtual keyboard/assistive technology and real provider NOT_TESTED. Hosted checks/workflows unavailable.

Workflow/decisions: docs/M1_MANUAL_STAGE_UX.md. Exact commands/results, failures, pins, screenshots, inventory scope and limitations: docs/M1_MANUAL_STAGE_UX_IMPLEMENTATION.md and docs/evidence/project-stage-ux/ on the PR branch. Original description/acceptance and blocker relationships remain intact. <issue id="81c8cdaf-bc0d-4920-aa0a-8f92dab921b6" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-24/sillynovel-m12-d0-prototype-session-only-manual-vn-stage">DYL-24</issue> session stage, <issue id="1af5b2ac-67e6-47c2-828e-90e1d655fd12" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-53/sillynovel-integrate-saved-projects-with-the-manual-vn-stage">DYL-53</issue> global projects and merged <issue id="9a7c483c-4df5-4d13-82fb-98d473df1c64" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-22/sillynovel-m12-c-import-and-register-a-small-approved-raster-asset">DYL-22</issue> first PNG catalog are credited separately; <issue id="9a7c483c-4df5-4d13-82fb-98d473df1c64" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-22/sillynovel-m12-c-import-and-register-a-small-approved-raster-asset">DYL-22</issue>'s broader original format/revision criteria remain unfinished.

GO for senior review of <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue>-A only. Original remaining <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue> acceptance includes attached source-expression overlays and source/history invalidation, native group/four-member duplicate-card integration, physical-device/accessibility evidence. Persistent message history/native correspondence, remembered attachment and single-writer/read-only-tab behavior remain excluded broader gate gaps. <issue id="7e3bbfd3-e744-45e2-916d-36684b74b159" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-23/sillynovel-m12-d-render-stable-manual-scenes-and-source-scoped">DYL-23</issue> is NOT Done; <issue id="705ea7ac-3580-47a4-87a8-863cd76f1ea7" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-60/sillynovel-m14-prepare-the-frozen-manual-stage-owner-playtest">DYL-60</issue> stays blocked. <issue id="918f7e83-b171-4601-b575-fa6c90f14884" href="https://linear.app/devils17/issue/DYL-55/sillynovel-add-portable-project-bundles-and-restore-policy">DYL-55</issue> unchanged, Decision F undecided, Gate A NOT_RUN, no M1.3/M2, release, live install, merge or auto-merge. Stop for senior review; do not begin later slices.
